question: Which management companies improved their fix times the most?
text:
The management companies that improved their fix times the most are those with the largest reductions in median days to fix. Notable data points include:
- Elm Property Management: improvement of 25.1 days (from 36.2 to 11.1)
- Prairie Property Management: improvement of 25.1 days (from 28.3 to 3.2)
- Union Property Management: improvement of 24.4 days (from 25.2 to 0.8)
- Mendota Property Management: improvement of 23.7 days (from 28.2 to 4.5)
- Maple Property Management: improvement of 22.7 days (from 34.9 to 12.2)

Elm and Prairie Property Management showed the greatest improvements, each reducing their median fix times by over 25 days.
sql:
WITH fix_times AS (
  SELECT o.management_company,
         ls.owner_id,
         ls.median_days_to_fix,
         ls.grade,
         ls.score
  FROM `fixit`.`gold`.`landlord_scores` ls
  JOIN `fixit`.`gold`.`owners` o ON ls.owner_id = o.owner_id
  WHERE ls.median_days_to_fix IS NOT NULL
    AND o.management_company IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_times AS (
  SELECT management_company,
         median_days_to_fix,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY management_company ORDER BY ls.median_days_to_fix ASC) AS rank_asc,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY management_company ORDER BY ls.median_days_to_fix DESC) AS rank_desc
  FROM fix_times ls
)
SELECT management_company,
       MIN(CASE WHEN rank_desc = 1 THEN median_days_to_fix END) AS previous_fix_time,
       MIN(CASE WHEN rank_asc = 1 THEN median_days_to_fix END) AS current_fix_time,
       (MIN(CASE WHEN rank_desc = 1 THEN median_days_to_fix END) - MIN(CASE WHEN rank_asc = 1 THEN median_days_to_fix END)) AS improvement
FROM ranked_times
GROUP BY management_company
HAVING improvement > 0
ORDER BY improvement DESC
